ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Conspiracy: Uncovering the Web of Childcare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future conspiracy and its connections to other childcare fraud cases in Minnesota.
questions: What were the methods used by the conspirators?
How did the conspiracy affect Minnesota's childcare system?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it exposes a large-scale conspiracy affecting vulnerable populations.
